proposals.reason: Seven adjacent transport files already form a named provider family. Keep them separate from the backend client.
proposals.review: Preserve exported registration symbols, IPC channel strings, request validation and registration order. Resolve any file-versus-directory entry ambiguity explicitly.

proposals.reason: Jira registration, request validation, cancellation and metadata handling belong together within IPC.
proposals.review: Preserve channels, cancellation ownership, site scope and registration order. Keep src/main/jira as the backend domain.

proposals.reason: The issue-context family covers resolution, optional includes, pagination and relations around one public read operation.
proposals.review: Keep the current-context, linked-workspace, inline-media and partial-error behavior intact; choose the public read-context entry explicitly.

proposals.reason: Attachment discovery, authenticated image fetching, grants, caching and protocols are a concrete subdomain.
proposals.review: Check image protocol registration, credential scope, cancellation and URL permissions; retain authenticated-request in its existing role.

proposals.reason: VM provisioning, recipe execution, resume and SSH cleanup currently occupy the application root.
proposals.review: Preserve provisioning and cleanup ownership, folder workspace support and remote environment behavior.

proposals.reason: Finish the existing feature folder instead of creating another feature root. Most provider routing needs a later review inside its existing provider folders.
proposals.review: Preserve React component identity, lazy-loading boundaries and task draft ownership. Retain basenames and route provider-specific files to existing children; split this scope into provider-sized PRs.

proposals.reason: Repository settings have one user-facing owner and a large mixed family of components, state and tests.
proposals.review: Keep draft-state boundaries and workspace-window routing; do not introduce an all-settings barrel.

proposals.reason: Status reduction, subscriptions and tests are scattered beside unrelated Zustand slices.
proposals.review: Keep the root store as the composition point. Preserve subscription and reduction semantics; keep an explicit slice entry.

proposals.reason: A concrete session-rule family can leave the 1,292-file renderer lib root without inventing a generic helpers directory.
proposals.review: Keep view rules in renderer and host rules in runtime. Review boundaries against native-chat before expanding the selection.

proposals.reason: Consolidate the flat filesystem and watcher families with the existing filesystem folder, then consider a watcher child.
proposals.review: Preserve parcel worker output names and process boundaries, file permissions, cancellation and mixed local/remote paths. Review the existing filesystem entry before moving.

proposals.reason: Consolidate flat terminal transport files into the existing pty tree after agreeing its ownership boundaries.
proposals.review: Preserve pane ownership, host identity, lifecycle ordering, Windows/WSL paths and daemon compatibility; use existing pty children when ownership is clear.

proposals.reason: Give pure Jira contracts and rules a domain home, matching the existing shared Linear domain.
proposals.review: Keep RPC schemas at their contract boundary unless a separate decision changes that layout. Preserve wire fields and all desktop/mobile consumers.

proposals.reason: Cookie reading, importing and cleanup are a concrete subsystem inside a 611-file directory.
proposals.review: Review browser session ownership, credential handling and native platform adapters. Do not combine this with browser API changes.

proposals.reason: Relay assignment is a named operational responsibility in an otherwise flat service root.
proposals.review: Use cloud's independent checks and deployment ownership. Preserve director/cell roles and rolling-version wire compatibility.

proposals.reason: Group one product-specific tool family; build-, run- and check- prefixes describe verbs, not ownership.
proposals.review: Update package scripts, CI workflows, script-relative URLs and test fixture copying. Separate a move from changing the generated web engines.

proposals.reason: Agent-session contracts are a large cross-surface domain currently encoded in filenames.
proposals.review: This is an initial ownership inventory, not a single PR. Identify public contracts and subdomains first; keep old-client fences and generated RPC files separate.

proposals.reason: Chat data and pure rules need a concrete domain home rather than hundreds of sibling names.
proposals.review: Review overlap with agent-session responsibility; retain wire-facing names and move in consumer-sized batches.

proposals.reason: Remote runtime handshake, capabilities and transport contracts are one discoverable protocol domain.
proposals.review: Preserve mixed-version client/server behavior. Rename source paths without renaming wire methods, protocol tags or capability fields.

proposals.reason: Session lifecycle and persistence should be discoverable below the runtime composition layer.
proposals.review: Partition acquisition, dispatch and observation by ownership before implementing; keep OrcaRuntime composition files and remote RPC surfaces explicit.

proposals.reason: The phone's chat family is mixed into a 722-file session folder, including presentation, interaction and hooks.
proposals.review: Use mobile's own workspace checks. Preserve native/web splits, hook identity, transport behavior and embedded WebView source paths.

proposals.reason: Structured Claude session execution is a distinct provider mode within an already named provider folder.
proposals.review: Review acquisition, process and journal boundaries. Preserve CLI launch flags, account routing and session recovery.

proposals.reason: The app-server protocol family is a more useful boundary than the broad codex filename prefix.
proposals.review: Preserve protocol, account routing, reconnect and recovery behavior. Keep generic Codex launch code outside this subtree.

proposals.reason: The existing persistence subtree and flat root tests split the same discovery trail.
proposals.review: Mostly tests and support may move here. Keep the current persistence entry explicit; inspect source-reading tests and fixtures before relocating. Preserve on-disk formats.
